name: retrotuner-ui
description: Control Volumio via a 16x2 display, rotary encoder and resistor ladder buttons
author: Dominic Bird

volumio_info.details: Control Volumio via a 16x2 display, rotary encoder and resistor ladder buttons
volumio_info.changelog: 3.1.0: Button reads now match raw ADC values against tolerance bands, with median sampling and hysteresis - fixes missed and misread presses. Adds Play All for playlists, albums and folders from any source; opt-in rotary track skip; and long-press stop/clear queue, remove favourite and cancel sleep timer. SPI fixes: manual CS, pinmux restore on mode switch, boot config check and reboot prompt. Settings page reorganised with a button capture flow, advanced timings and a debug logging toggle. Packaged venv, dependency clash fixed, control API bound to loopback. 3.0.0: Renamed project. Improved code quality and performance. Added additional controls.
